Question: How many claims have been placed by policy number?
Generated Query:
SELECT
    p.Policy_Number,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.Claim_Identifier) AS Claim_Count
FROM Claim c
JOIN Insurable_Object io
    ON c.Insurable_Object_Identifier = io.Insurable_Object_Identifier
JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
    ON pcd.Insurable_Object_Identifier = io.Insurable_Object_Identifier
JOIN Policy p
    ON p.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
GROUP BY
    p.Policy_Number
ORDER BY
    p.Policy_Number;

Question: How many claims have been placed by policy number?
What is the total amount of premiums paid by policy number?
Generated Query:
SELECT
    p.Policy_Number,
    SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS Total_Premiums_Paid
FROM Policy_Amount pa
INNER JOIN Policy p
    ON pa.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
WHERE pa.Amount_Type_Code = 'PREM'
GROUP BY p.Policy_Number
ORDER BY p.Policy_Number;

Question: What is the total amount of premiums paid by policy number?
What is the total loss amounts, which is the sum of loss payment, loss reserve amount by claim number?
Generated Query:
SELECT
    c.Company_Claim_Number AS claim_number,
    SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) +
    SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS total_loss_amount
FROM Claim c
JOIN Claim_Amount ca
    ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Loss_Payment lp
    ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Loss_Reserve lr
    ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
WHERE lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
   OR lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.Company_Claim_Number;

Question: What are all the premiums that have been paid by policy holders?
What are the loss payment, loss reserve, expense payment, expense reserve amount by claim number?
Generated Query:
SELECT
    c.Claim_Number,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN cp.Amount END), 0) AS Loss_Payment_Amount,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN cr.Amount END), 0) AS Loss_Reserve_Amount,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN cp2.Amount END), 0) AS Expense_Payment_Amount,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN cr2.Amount END), 0) AS Expense_Reserve_Amount
FROM Claim c
LEFT JOIN Claim_Payment cp
    ON cp.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Loss_Payment lp
    ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = cp.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Claim_Reserve cr
    ON cr.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Loss_Reserve lr
    ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = cr.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Claim_Payment cp2
    ON cp2.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Expense_Payment ep
    ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = cp2.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Claim_Reserve cr2
    ON cr2.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Expense_Reserve er
    ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = cr2.Claim_Amount_Identifier
GROUP BY c.Claim_Number;
